answer: Proof-of-history resists sybil attacks in agent economies by binding identity to a verifiable chain of past actions. Like rings in timber, each behavior layer accumulates over time and cannot be fabricated instantly. Ghost agents cannot backdate this history because actions are sequentially hashed. Matching one honest veteran requires sustaining real computation across the timeline. Even if a hostile swarm pours through an inlet, each member starts at zero depth and stays marginal until it accrues genuine history. A nebula of fakes thus yields negligible influence.
